growthGuide.title: How growth works
growthGuide.intro: Your buddy is a light companion for research mood—not a hardcore pet game. It reacts when the system is busy, and grows mainly when you confirm real research progress.
growthGuide.earnBody:
XP is awarded on your confirmation, not when a model merely finishes generating:
• Literature — export the review packet
• Idea — send a card into Experiment
• Experiment — lock the recipe
• Writing — export the draft
• Polish — accept a semantic diff
• Figures — complete the QC checklist
• Review — confirm every response outline item
Daily check-in also gives a small boost. Chatting only plays happy animations—no research XP.
growthGuide.statsBody:
• XP / Level — research progress; higher levels take more XP
• Friendship — closeness from confirmed work and care
• Sparks — inspiration tokens (shown now; more uses later)
• Energy — recovers over time; dips if you leave for days
• Mood — soft emotional state; the buddy never dies
growthGuide.stagesBody: Hatchling → Scout (≤Lv.5) → Apprentice (≤Lv.12) → Critic (≤Lv.20) → Partner. Stages are labels for your journey, not harsh penalties.
growthGuide.rulesBody: Each reward type has a daily cap to prevent grinding. You can rename your buddy and lock a main look, or let the skin follow the active model. Progress is saved locally in this browser.
